Name: Meadowlands Farm Remakened
Author: StardewValleyPixelArt01
Description:
Meadowlands Farm:
I made it one of the best farms among other farms, I revamped it and added advantages to this farm with the aim that players can use one farm with one, namely multipurpose.

Additions For Farm:
- You can plant any type of seed plant in any season, without worrying that your plants will die when the seasons change.

- Players can fish for the same types of fish as in a lake, without worrying about getting trash when trying to fish on a regular farm.

- players can put crab pots on the farm.

- Now your farm has been adjusted, the color of the earth doesn't need to be added using the earth coloring mod, because the color of the agricultural land has already been adjusted.

- If you run out of land for farming, don't worry, you can use every new location as a farm to plant crops or seeds.

- Bringing up wild plants or wild foods, on a farm or new location.

- Now you don't need to worry about being penalized for passing out on the farm or in a new location.

- You can put the refrigerator outside the house, the cask can be put outside the house too, and players can cook outside the house without having to go back into the house to go to the kitchen to cook food.

- Now you can mine, browse, fish, Livestock, farm, fight which is prepared in the new cave on your farm.
